one_line_contribution: A pre-registered ALFWorld measurement of what fraction of a retrieved procedural-memory bank's value is already held by a GEPA-optimized instruction written from the identical training episodes, identified by a task-type x episode-provenance crossover square (instruction provenance x bank provenance) and reported as an absorbed share A = 1 - Inner(I_own)/Inner(I_oth) plus a residual gain g(I_own, B_own), each with an interval and a truth table fixing which of six titles is claimed.
closest_prior_work: ExpeL (arXiv 2308.10144) is the work that most threatens novelty, and the proposal now concedes it: ExpeL distils training episodes into a prepended insights block AND retrieves trajectories, ablates each container separately against the full system, and does so in ALFWorld. That is a two-container redundancy measurement in this exact environment, in print since 2023. The proposal's remaining increment is provenance labelling (which episodes filled which container) plus pairing, token matching and CIs. EvoAgentBench (arXiv 2607.05202) supplies the qualitative headline (ReasoningBank +3.6 vs GEPA +1.2 on the same 528/267 trajectories), AutoManual (arXiv 2405.16247) and AutoGuide (arXiv 2403.08978) already rewrite ALFWorld experience as instruction text and show a compiled manual competing with retrieval, and MIPROv2 (arXiv 2406.11695) established the instruction-vs-demonstration split on one training set. One further prior the proposal never cites and should: the instruction-induction / APE line (Honovich et al. 2022; Zhou et al., Large Language Models Are Human-Level Prompt Engineers, 2022), which is literally 'compile demonstrations into an instruction' and is the substitution hypothesis in its original form. Taken together the qualitative claim, the ALFWorld setting, the compiled-block arm and the two-container ablation are all pre-empted; what is left is a number under provenance control, and the design is not powered to deliver that number (see strongest_objection).
strongest_objection: The design is well powered exactly where it is not novel, and under-powered exactly where it is novel. Everything the proposal concedes to ExpeL and EvoAgentBench (a two-container comparison of a bank against an optimizer-written instruction) is carried by rows 1-3 at n = 1,200 with two optimizer seeds. The one thing claimed as new -- separating 'the instruction absorbed THESE episodes' from 'the instruction learned this task type' from 'the instruction was told which types are coming' -- is carried entirely by three arms that the proposal itself de-thresholds: Ladder T's A_epi (row 4, n = 500, one seed, interpolated denominator, SE(A_epi) ~ 0.30, explicitly 'reported with CIs and not thresholded'), row 19's I_type contrast (n = 500, SE ~ 2.6pt, so only a >= 4.3pt gap is distinguishable and a CI covering zero is pre-registered as merely 'not excluding' the type-label rival), and row 17's B'_own, which risk 26 concedes answers a different question (whether the BANK is type-generic, not whether the INSTRUCTION absorbed these episodes). So on a clean pass the paper can report A and g -- quantities whose qualitative answer is already published -- while the episode-vs-type-vs-label identification that is supposed to be the entire contribution is descriptive only. A reviewer will say: strip the under-powered arms and this is ExpeL's ablation with paired statistics; keep them and they cannot bear a claim. Compounding it, the confirmatory conjunction is nearly unreachable by construction (endpoint E is declarable only when the observed residual |g-hat| <= 0.68pt, risk 34 says so), G3 at 9pt is called 'a deliberate coin flip', and A vs A0 are strongly correlated ratios sharing a numerator but judged against differently derived floors (0.2 vs a matched-gap null's 95th percentile planned at 0.25-0.30, itself estimated from the same n = 500 single-seed row 4 whose SE is ~0.30). Truth-table row 6 -- 'exactly one of A, A0 passes, the disagreement IS the finding' (title T3) -- is therefore a highly likely outcome driven by the authors' choice of two floors rather than by anything about memory, and shipping that as a finding would not survive review.
what_would_fix_it: Reallocate power rather than add experiments. (1) Make the novel identification the confirmatory endpoint: put row 4 (Ladder T), row 19 (I_type) and row 17 (B'_own) at n = 1,200 with two optimizer seeds and threshold A_epi / the Inner(I_type) - Inner(I_own) contrast, and pay for it by deleting the arms the proposal itself says carry no novelty -- row 11 (compile-once, conceded as replication of AutoManual), row 12 (J), row 16 (A_all, a diagnostic that gates nothing) and the whole third-denominator apparatus. If the design cannot afford a powered episode-vs-type test, the paper should say so and drop 'same episodes, two containers' from its title. (2) Collapse the co-primary pair: pick ONE denominator on principled grounds (A0 at the hand-written scaffold is the interpretable one) and report the others as sensitivity, so that row 6's 'disagreement is the finding' cannot fire on a threshold artifact. (3) Re-tune the retrieval budget k on dev separately at I0*, I_oth and I_own and report the absorbed share at each condition's own optimal injection volume -- the track brief's own measured prior is that injection VOLUME, not content, was the causal lever, and the design pins k across instructions of very different lengths. (4) Run pre-freeze obligation (1), the provenance/data-attribution crossover search, and read ExpeL's ablation table BEFORE writing the paper, not before submission; the novelty argument is currently conditional on a search that has never been run. (5) Cut the version-history scaffolding ('v5.2 said X, withdrawn in v5.3') and the six-title truth table down to a paper a reviewer can hold in their head.
missing_baseline: The bank retrieved at I_own with the injection budget k re-tuned at I_own. 'HELD FIXED THROUGHOUT' pins k to a single dev tuning run and holds it across I0*, I_oth and I_own, but the optimized instruction is a much longer prompt than the hand-written scaffold, so the memory-to-context ratio -- not just the memory content -- differs across every cell of the square and across A0's whole level gap. The track's own prior result, quoted in the brief, is that cutting injection from seven items to three eliminated the harm from the SAME bank, i.e. volume was the causal lever; and the proposal itself cites retrieval-pollution, context-competition and dilution findings (arXiv 2604.27003, arXiv 2608.15008). A reviewer will therefore demand the budget-matched arm: if the optimal k at I_own is smaller and re-tuning restores the bank's advantage, the 'absorbed share' is a statement about over-injection into a longer prompt, not about content moving between containers. Neither X_dist (row 8) nor M_shuf (row 18) covers this, because both are token-matched to B_own at the SAME fixed k. A second, cheaper omission: no Tier-0 arm anchors the setup to any published ALFWorld system on the official valid_seen/valid_unseen splits (that is Tier 1), so the 5-15pt literature prior the whole design is calibrated against is never verified in-house at Tier 0; risk 24 names this as a bridging assumption but leaves it untested at the tier that ships. Third, and pointed given the track's title: I2 (instruction optimized with the bank in context, row 13) -- the only arm that tests coupling in a track called 'Coupling Self-Editing Memory with Prompt Optimization' -- is demoted to Tier 1 and may not run at all.
preprint_collision: The check is unusually thorough in form -- dated scans (2026-09-03, prior 2026-08-21), 15 HuggingFace queries over 244 papers, by-id verification for 54 arXiv IDs, per-ID verification channel recorded, one PDF read in full with a committed SHA256, and a correction of a mis-scraped number (ReasoningBank +7 -> +3.6). It is far better than the norm and it makes real concessions rather than defensive ones: ExpeL's ablation is conceded as a measurement collision and 'nobody has reported the number' is explicitly withdrawn; EvoAgentBench is conceded as publishing the qualitative headline; AutoManual and AutoGuide are conceded as pre-empting the compile-once arm in this exact environment. But it has NOT established novelty, for three reasons the proposal states itself. First, all five pre-freeze obligations are UNRUN, including the freeze-blocking one -- the search for held-out-episode / data-provenance crossovers in the prompt-optimization, contamination and data-attribution literatures -- and that primitive is the whole of the claimed identification. Asking a reviewer to accept a novelty claim explicitly conditional on a search that has never been performed is asking for a conditional accept of an unconditional claim. Second, the scan's recall is demonstrably poor on precisely this framing: the two most damaging precedents (AutoManual 2405.16247 and AutoGuide 2403.08978, both ALFWorld, both pre-2026) were supplied by a reviewer, not found by the scan, which is direct evidence that the 2023-2025 window -- where 'rewrite episodes as instruction text' actually originates -- was not covered. The APE / instruction-induction line (Honovich et al. 2022; Zhou et al. 2022) is still missing from the scan and is a closer framing ancestor than several of the 2026 IDs cited. Third, arXiv is unreachable from the node, so every 2026 ID except EvoAgentBench rests on a single web-snippet channel and every 'confirmed absent from the paper' claim about a competitor is asserted from an abstract; one such snippet has already been shown wrong. I cannot name a specific recent preprint that makes exactly the provenance-controlled claim, but the correct reading is that the check has not looked in the place where such a collision would live, and an unsearched claim of novelty is a weakness. On the specific named live collision -- the unopened appendix of arXiv 2608.14036 for a token-matched compiled-block-vs-retrieval comparison -- the proposal is right that this would gut prediction 6, and it should be resolved before submission rather than listed as an obligation.
